items.name: Fibre
items.function: Plant and root strands that hold a charge after harvest.
items.role: Basic crafting input for bindings, filters, field kits and light armor.
items.acquire: Gather from living growth; Veridan and Sylvanir favor it.
items.note: Pairs with Data and Scrap for utility recipes.

items.name: Scrap
items.function: Broken housings, wire, plate and useful machine fragments.
items.role: Universal salvage input for repair, fabrication and improvised defenses.
items.acquire: Salvage wrecks, ruins and defeated machines.
items.note: Pairs with Data for machines; with Fibre for field gear.

items.name: Crystal
items.function: Resonant mineral that stores Astralite signatures.
items.role: Power, focusing and bonding component for advanced builds.
items.acquire: Mine crystal seams and recover resonance shards.
items.note: Pairs with Data for scanners; with Relics for prism work.

items.name: Data
items.function: Encoded survey memory from machines, ruins and living systems.
items.role: Blueprint, map and research currency for unlocks.
items.acquire: Scan ruins, terminals and anomaly fields.
items.note: Pairs with Crystal for analysis and with Scrap for fabrication.

items.name: Relics
items.function: Recovered artifacts whose original makers are no longer known.
items.role: Rare key material for world history, bond technology and endgame builds.
items.acquire: Find in vaults, shrines, chests and landmark trials.
items.note: Pairs with Crystal for Prismshards; never treated as generic scrap.

items.name: Rubycore
items.function: Dense red substrate that keeps heat without losing shape.
items.role: Heat cells, forge parts and explosive charge stabilizers.
items.acquire: Mine ruby caverns and volcanic fractures.
items.note: Boosts Ember Salve and Ignara machines.

items.name: Pearlglass
items.function: Ocean-grown glass with a soft internal glow.
items.role: Water systems, healing vessels and signal lenses.
items.acquire: Harvest from deep reefs and devotional tide sites.
items.note: Pairs with Fibre for med kits and with Data for sonar.

items.name: Aether Reed
items.function: Lightweight reed that records touch as a fading pattern.
items.role: Flexible sensor strips and stealth signal lines.
items.acquire: Cut from recorder groves and perception marshes.
items.note: Pairs with Data for Field Scanner upgrades.

items.name: Gravestone
items.function: Heavy mineral that anchors objects against force and drift.
items.role: Weight modules, bunker frames and recoil dampers.
items.acquire: Excavate gravity wells and collapse zones.
items.note: Pairs with Scrap for Shield Generator frames.

items.name: Stormsalt
items.function: Crystallized static left where storms strike mineral ground.
items.role: High-voltage charge and weather instrument material.
items.acquire: Collect after electrical storms or from storm towers.
items.note: Pairs with Data for Chrono Beacon and Signal Tower.

items.name: Frostvein
items.function: Blue-white ice that holds a moment in suspension.
items.role: Cryo storage, cooling loops and status cure components.
items.acquire: Mine stasis caves; rare drops from frozen vaults.
items.note: Core ingredient for Thawgrid and clone storage.

items.name: Verdant Resin
items.function: Living resin that seals without killing what it covers.
items.role: Organic construction adhesive and habitat growth starter.
items.acquire: Tap world-tree roots and grove structures.
items.note: Pairs with Fibre for Habitat Pods and Worldseed Planters.

items.name: Voidglass
items.function: Opaque glass that absorbs a signal before returning it changed.
items.role: Stealth screens, null keys and anti-scan housings.
items.acquire: Recover from silent rooms and hidden-awareness sites.
items.note: Pairs with Data for Seer Interdictors.

items.name: Skyfoil
items.function: Thin metallic leaf shed by floating infrastructure.
items.role: Lightweight lift surfaces and jet systems.
items.acquire: Strip abandoned sky platforms and predator nests.
items.note: Pairs with Scrap for Jetpack and Skyhook builds.

items.name: Tidebone
items.function: Salt-cured skeletal material from ancient oceanic megafauna.
items.role: Durable grips, handles and shock-safe tool bodies.
items.acquire: Find along tidal shelves and wreck beaches.
items.note: Pairs with Pearlglass for healing equipment.

items.name: Memory Ink
items.function: Dark liquid that stores a short sensory recording.
items.role: Quest evidence, map annotation and memory archive input.
items.acquire: Collect from recorder shrines and sealed archives.
items.note: Pairs with Data for Archive and AstraNav research.

items.name: Chronofiber
items.function: Thread that moves a fraction of a second ahead of the hand.
items.role: Timing circuits, reload tools and movement enhancers.
items.acquire: Harvest from time-accelerated ruins.
items.note: Pairs with Aether Reed for Chrono Beacon parts.

items.name: Astralite Dust
items.function: Fine universal substrate shed by damaged crystal formations.
items.role: High-grade resonance catalyst for machines and modifications.
items.acquire: Extract from cosmic seams and guardian aftermaths.
items.note: Pairs with Relics for Prismshard and Fathergem work.

items.name: Ironroot
items.function: Metal-veined root that grows through old industrial soil.
items.role: Structural braces and living-machine frames.
items.acquire: Harvest around Ferros foundries and abandoned rootworks.
items.note: Pairs with Verdant Resin for Worldseed Planters.

items.name: Embercoil
items.function: Coiled heat-metal that glows without consuming fuel.
items.role: Compact power, weapon heat sinks and emergency lighting.
items.acquire: Recover from forge ruins and burning sites.
items.note: Pairs with Stormsalt for Generator builds.

items.name: Prismshard
items.function: Ancient vessel fragment designed to stabilize bonded Astralite energy.
items.role: Elite bond focus; supports legendary gear and Prism synch.
items.acquire: Find through ancient Bond Master trials; never bought.
items.note: Pairs with Relics and Astralite Dust; distinct from the sixteen Prisms.

items.name: Seer Thread
items.function: Black filament used to bind ritual equipment and living targets.
items.role: Dangerous research material for tracking and counter-ritual devices.
items.acquire: Recover from Seer facilities after dismantling them.
items.note: Pairs with Voidglass for Seer Interdictors.

items.name: Gemshard
items.function: Broken shard carrying one Gemlord district signature.
items.role: District progression key and shrine restoration component.
items.acquire: Earn from sanctuaries, respect fights and major quests.
items.note: Pairs with Data for Gemlord Shrine calibration.

items.name: Auric Alloy
items.function: Gold-bright alloy from preserved Aur-line instruments.
items.role: Premium frame material for endgame machines and relic tools.
items.acquire: Recover from Viridian vaults and royal infrastructure.
items.note: Pairs with Ironroot for Fathergem Resonator frames.

items.name: Wisp Salt
items.function: Powder left behind when a local spirit crosses a boundary.
items.role: Portable spirit signal, warding and companion-support component.
items.acquire: Gather near shrines and after wisp encounters.
items.note: Pairs with Memory Ink for companion and archive systems.

items.name: Anomaly Core
items.function: Unstable core from a body outside the ordered cycle.
items.role: Endgame wildcard power source with volatile outcomes.
items.acquire: Extract from drift anomalies and Worldender encounters.
items.note: Pairs with Voidglass for Rift Anchor and anomaly gear.

items.name: Worldseed
items.function: Dormant seed containing a complete local habitat pattern.
items.role: Long-term settlement, biome restoration and base expansion input.
items.acquire: Earn from world-tree guardians and ecological sidequests.
items.note: Pairs with Verdant Resin for Habitat Pod and Worldseed Planter.

items.name: Rocketship
items.function: Vehicle platform for planetary departure, re-entry and high-risk traversal.
items.role: Unlocks world transitions, emergency extraction and ship upgrades.
items.acquire: Developer chest first; later built from Skyfoil, Scrap and Data.
items.note: Core travel machine; powered by Generator and tuned by Workstation.

items.name: AstraNav
items.function: Handheld navigation, survey, scanner and living expedition record.
items.role: Reveals worlds, tracks discoveries and opens the click-through game hub.
items.acquire: Issued at expedition start; upgradeable with Data and Crystal.
items.note: Universal UI anchor; reads Field Scanner, Signal Tower and Rift Anchor.

items.name: Workstation
items.function: Modular bench for recipes, machine tuning and item testing.
items.role: Turns raw materials into machines and modifications.
items.acquire: Starting room chest; later craft from Scrap, Data and Ironroot.
items.note: The main crafting gate for the whole item system.

items.name: Cloning Pod
items.function: Biological chamber that stabilizes a scanned creature pattern.
items.role: Converts a valid scan into a companion or training specimen.
items.acquire: Starting room chest; later built from Pearlglass, Frostvein and Data.
items.note: Uses AstraNav scans, Wisp Salt and Memory Ink.

items.name: Generator
items.function: Compact power plant that turns heat and static into stable output.
items.role: Powers nearby machines and enables base upgrades.
items.acquire: Starting room chest; later built from Embercoil, Stormsalt and Scrap.
items.note: Required for advanced Workstation, Shield Generator and Warp Gate.

items.name: Jetpack
items.function: Personal lift rig for controlled vertical movement and short glides.
items.role: Adds traversal routes, emergency recovery and aerial combat positioning.
items.acquire: Starting room chest; later built from Skyfoil, Scrap and Chronofiber.
items.note: Consumes Generator charge; interacts with Gravestone and Stormsalt.

items.name: Prismshard Loom
items.function: Bench that stabilizes a bonded pair through a carved vessel.
items.role: Crafts elite bond modules and Prismshard-linked gear.
items.acquire: Ancient trial reward; never mass-produced.
items.note: Requires Prismshard, Relics and Astralite Dust.

items.name: Zysphere Press
items.function: Industrial press for shaping modern bonding vessels.
items.role: Crafts Zyspheres, Zycubes and future utility vessels.
items.acquire: Build at Workstation from Scrap, Crystal and Data.
items.note: Supports capture economy without replacing bond trust.

items.name: Astralite Refinery
items.function: Controlled chamber for separating pure substrate from contaminated material.
items.role: Upgrades Crystal, Astralite Dust and Gemshards into high-grade components.
items.acquire: Build from Crystal, Embercoil and Data after refinery research.
items.note: Requires Generator; risks anomaly contamination.

items.name: Field Scanner
items.function: Deployable ground unit that maps local terrain, signatures and movement.
items.role: Creates live map data and marks resource, creature and structure nodes.
items.acquire: Craft at Workstation from Data, Aether Reed and Scrap.
items.note: Feeds AstraNav and Memory Archive.

items.name: Salvage Bench
items.function: Portable machine for dismantling wrecks without losing useful parts.
items.role: Improves Scrap yield and reveals hidden machine components.
items.acquire: Build from Scrap, Ironroot and Fibre.
items.note: Pairs with Rocketship crash sites and machine-world ruins.

items.name: Fabricator
items.function: Automated constructor for repeatable field hardware.
items.role: Builds common tools, chest parts and base utilities.
items.acquire: Build from Scrap, Data and Generator output.
items.note: Reduces routine crafting friction; Workstation sets recipes.

items.name: Power Relay
items.function: Short-range energy distribution node.
items.role: Extends Generator power across a base or expedition outpost.
items.acquire: Build from Scrap, Stormsalt and Fibre.
items.note: Enables multi-machine rooms and remote scanners.

items.name: Rift Anchor
items.function: Anchor that pins a safe position inside unstable space.
items.role: Creates a return point for extraction and anomaly runs.
items.acquire: Build from Anomaly Core, Voidglass and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Rocketship and AstraNav; failure creates risk.

items.name: Gravity Lift
items.function: Localized lift column for vertical base and ruin traversal.
items.role: Opens high routes, elevator shortcuts and sky-island access.
items.acquire: Build from Gravestone, Skyfoil and Generator power.
items.note: Pairs with Jetpack for traversal puzzles.

items.name: Bioforge
items.function: Organic fabrication chamber for tissue, root and habitat materials.
items.role: Processes Fibre, Tidebone, Verdant Resin and Worldseed.
items.acquire: Build from Pearlglass, Verdant Resin and Data.
items.note: Required for Habitat Pod, cloning support and healing mods.

items.name: Habitat Pod
items.function: Sealed starter habitat that unfolds into a livable field room.
items.role: Establishes a temporary safe room, storage and recovery point.
items.acquire: Build from Worldseed, Fibre and Pearlglass.
items.note: Powered by Generator; upgrades through Worldseed Planter.

items.name: Hydroponic Vat
items.function: Closed-loop growth tank for water, roots and medicinal crops.
items.role: Produces Fibre, Verdant Resin and healing ingredients over time.
items.acquire: Build from Pearlglass, Fibre and Scrap.
items.note: Turns base time into reliable material income.

items.name: Weather Array
items.function: Atmospheric instrument that predicts and shapes local weather windows.
items.role: Reveals storms, changes traversal conditions and improves rare drops.
items.acquire: Build from Stormsalt, Data and Skyfoil.
items.note: Feeds live AstraNav scanner states.

items.name: Chrono Beacon
items.function: Beacon that marks a stable time signature in a changing zone.
items.role: Creates timed events, temporary shortcuts and repeatable challenge windows.
items.acquire: Build from Chronofiber, Memory Ink and Stormsalt.
items.note: Pairs with Thawgrid and Rift Anchor.

items.name: Memory Archive
items.function: Station for storing scanned places, voices and expedition records.
items.role: Preserves discoveries and unlocks lore-linked recipes or routes.
items.acquire: Build from Data, Memory Ink and Voidglass.
items.note: Feeds AstraNav journal and companion records.

items.name: Signal Tower
items.function: Long-range transmitter for expedition, distress and settlement signals.
items.role: Calls NPC help, reveals merchant routes and marks the base on world maps.
items.acquire: Build from Aether Reed, Stormsalt and Scrap.
items.note: Extends AstraNav and Distress Beacon range.

items.name: Drone Nest
items.function: Launch bay for small autonomous scouts.
items.role: Sends drones to tag resources, enemies and hidden paths.
items.acquire: Build from Scrap, Skyfoil and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Field Scanner and Signal Tower.

items.name: Shield Generator
items.function: Defensive field emitter that protects a room or extraction point.
items.role: Creates a holdout zone during storms, raids and world events.
items.acquire: Build from Gravestone, Embercoil and Generator output.
items.note: Consumes Power Relay capacity; protects Habitat Pods.

items.name: Seer Interdictor
items.function: Counter-ritual machine that interrupts sacrifice infrastructure.
items.role: Disables Seer machinery, opens crisis sites and changes world consequences.
items.acquire: Build from Seer Thread, Voidglass and Data.
items.note: Story-critical machine; requires Memory Archive evidence.

items.name: Gemlord Shrine
items.function: Restoration machine that aligns a district Gemshard to its sanctuary.
items.role: Unlocks district boons, respect fights and local fast travel.
items.acquire: Constructed at each sanctuary from Gemshard, Crystal and Relics.
items.note: Progression machine tied to the ten-district arc.

items.name: Fathergem Resonator
items.function: Endgame chamber tuned to the Father Gem and Aur-Veridae lineage.
items.role: Opens the highest bond, relic and post-game world interactions.
items.acquire: Built from Auric Alloy, Astralite Dust and major relic evidence.
items.note: Late-game machine; never appears as ordinary loot.

items.name: Soulanchor
items.function: Consumable antidote that clears Souldrift and prevents one overworld tick.
items.role: Survival essential for long expeditions and spirit zones.
items.acquire: Craft at Workstation from Wisp Salt, Memory Ink and Fibre.
items.note: Directly follows the Codex five-status antidote rule.

items.name: Groundwire
items.function: Consumable antidote that clears Undershock and grounds the next shock.
items.role: Restores movement tempo after machine or lightning attacks.
items.acquire: Craft from Scrap, Stormsalt and Ironroot.
items.note: Best against machine-world hazards and Generator failures.

items.name: Coolgrass
items.function: Consumable antidote that clears Overcook and grants brief heat resistance.
items.role: Keeps forge, fire and volcanic routes playable.
items.acquire: Craft from Fibre, Verdant Resin and Embercoil.
items.note: Pairs with Jetpack over Ignara heat vents.

items.name: Thawgrid
items.function: Consumable antidote that clears Gridlock and restores signal timing.
items.role: Reopens abilities and machines slowed by frozen time.
items.acquire: Craft from Frostvein, Chronofiber and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Chrono Beacon and Memory Archive.

items.name: Mindmend
items.function: Consumable antidote that clears Psychache and restores scan focus.
items.role: Protects navigation, targeting and companion commands.
items.acquire: Craft from Memory Ink, Pearlglass and Wisp Salt.
items.note: Pairs with AstraNav and Cloning Pod.

items.name: Field Patch
items.function: Fast-use repair wrap that restores a small amount of suit durability.
items.role: Basic sustain between fights without returning to base.
items.acquire: Craft from Fibre and Tidebone.
items.note: Stacks with Habitat Pod recovery.

items.name: Prism Salve
items.function: Resonant salve that restores a small amount of Astralite charge.
items.role: Lets bond and machine abilities stay active in the field.
items.acquire: Craft from Crystal, Pearlglass and Astralite Dust.
items.note: Amplifies Prismshard Loom effects.

items.name: Static Coil
items.function: Single-use charge pack that instantly powers one machine action.
items.role: Emergency restart for scanners, relays and extraction tools.
items.acquire: Craft from Stormsalt and Scrap.
items.note: Useful when Generator output is offline.

items.name: Null Veil
items.function: Wearable field mod that hides the player from one scan pulse.
items.role: Supports stealth routes, Seer infiltration and rare loot recovery.
items.acquire: Craft from Voidglass, Fibre and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Seer Interdictor and Field Scanner.

items.name: Skyhook Cartridge
items.function: Consumable grapple charge that pulls the player to a marked anchor.
items.role: Creates fast vertical traversal and escape routes.
items.acquire: Craft from Skyfoil, Scrap and Chronofiber.
items.note: Pairs with Jetpack and Gravity Lift.

items.name: Grav Clamp
items.function: Temporary boot mod that prevents knockback and sliding.
items.role: Lets the player hold a position during storms and heavy impacts.
items.acquire: Craft from Gravestone, Ironroot and Scrap.
items.note: Pairs with Shield Generator.

items.name: Ember Charge
items.function: Single-use thermal charge for powered tools and controlled demolition.
items.role: Opens blocked routes and overloads hostile machines.
items.acquire: Craft from Embercoil and Rubycore.
items.note: Works with Rocketship salvage and Salvage Bench.

items.name: Frost Capsule
items.function: Portable cold cell that preserves a resource, sample or companion state.
items.role: Prevents decay during long travel and protects rare finds.
items.acquire: Craft from Frostvein, Pearlglass and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Cloning Pod and Bioforge.

items.name: Memory Tag
items.function: One-use tag that records a person, location or event in perfect detail.
items.role: Turns exploration evidence into journal and quest progress.
items.acquire: Craft from Memory Ink and Aether Reed.
items.note: Feeds Memory Archive and AstraNav.

items.name: Signal Flare
items.function: Bright emergency flare visible across a local region.
items.role: Calls help, reveals the player to allies and marks an extraction point.
items.acquire: Craft from Stormsalt, Fibre and Scrap.
items.note: Pairs with Signal Tower and Rocketship extraction.

items.name: Decoy Beacon
items.function: Portable false signature that draws creatures or patrols away.
items.role: Creates stealth openings and controls encounter spacing.
items.acquire: Craft from Data, Voidglass and Aether Reed.
items.note: Pairs with Null Veil and Seer sites.

items.name: Scan Prism
items.function: Consumable lens that guarantees one clean scan of a hidden signature.
items.role: Converts an uncertain encounter into useful archive data.
items.acquire: Craft from Crystal, Data and Pearlglass.
items.note: Pairs with Field Scanner and Cloning Pod.

items.name: Bond Lattice
items.function: Temporary bond mod that improves synchronization stability for one encounter.
items.role: Raises the reliability of Bond Moves without removing trust requirements.
items.acquire: Craft from Prismshard, Fibre and Astralite Dust.
items.note: Pairs with Prismshard Loom and Zysphere Press.

items.name: Repair Swarm
items.function: Disposable micro-drone cloud that restores a damaged machine over time.
items.role: Repairs machines during a run while the player keeps moving.
items.acquire: Craft from Scrap, Data and Ironroot.
items.note: Pairs with Salvage Bench and Power Relay.

items.name: Overdrive Cell
items.function: Single-use power cell that doubles one machine output and risks heat.
items.role: Creates high-stakes extraction moments and emergency speed.
items.acquire: Craft from Embercoil, Stormsalt and Rubycore.
items.note: Best on Rocketship, Generator and Shield Generator.

items.name: Habitat Seal
items.function: Consumable seal that instantly stabilizes a damaged Habitat Pod.
items.role: Keeps a temporary safe room alive after attacks or storms.
items.acquire: Craft from Verdant Resin, Fibre and Tidebone.
items.note: Pairs with Habitat Pod and Hydroponic Vat.

items.name: Rift Marker
items.function: Single-use marker that records a safe return coordinate in unstable space.
items.role: Allows a planned retreat from anomaly runs.
items.acquire: Craft from Anomaly Core, Data and Voidglass.
items.note: Pairs with Rift Anchor and AstraNav.

items.name: Gemlord Sigil
items.function: Consumable shrine token that reveals one hidden district resonance.
items.role: Guides exploration toward sanctuaries, secrets and respect fights.
items.acquire: Earn from district elders, not ordinary merchants.
items.note: Pairs with Gemlord Shrine and Gemshards.

items.name: Seer Breaker
items.function: One-use disruptor that cancels a ritual node or patrol alarm.
items.role: Turns sabotage into a readable, repeatable gameplay tool.
items.acquire: Craft from Seer Thread, Stormsalt and Data.
items.note: Pairs with Seer Interdictor.

items.name: Worldseed Charge
items.function: Consumable growth charge that expands a habitat or restores a damaged biome patch.
items.role: Makes restoration visible and rewards return trips.
items.acquire: Craft from Worldseed, Verdant Resin and Fibre.
items.note: Pairs with Worldseed Planter and Hydroponic Vat.

items.name: Auric Overprint
items.function: Temporary relic coating that lets one tool interface with ancient Aur machinery.
items.role: Opens lineage-locked doors and endgame devices.
items.acquire: Craft from Auric Alloy, Relics and Memory Ink.
items.note: Pairs with Fathergem Resonator and Anciuxor home-cycle content.

items.name: Anomaly Fuse
items.function: Volatile consumable that converts an anomaly into a brief burst of power.
items.role: High-risk shortcut for extraction, crafting or boss phases.
